basic_info.description: Detached mid-century home in Midtown Terrace with sweeping Pacific Ocean and city views. Bright, open layout features hardwood floors, a wood-burning fireplace, and amazing ocean views from the living room. Three bedrooms and one bath are on the main level plus a versatile lower-level guest suite with a private entrance, spa-like bath, and an additional designer half-bath with imported Italian tiles and a modern vanity ideal for guests, office, or studio. The open floor plan includes a recently remodeled Chef's kitchen with quartz countertops, a commercial Wolf gas stove, stainless appliances, and flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas. Upstairs has one bath with high-end fixtures, designer tile, and an extra-deep tub.  Landscaped and turfed backyard with fire pit and space for outdoor dining. Single-level entry, one-car garage with Tesla charger, and ample street parking. Close to Twin Peaks, Sutro Forest, top-rated schools, and vibrant neighborhoods like Cole Valley, Castro, and Inner Sunset. Easy access to Forest Hill Muni.
